name: Alex Sindalovsky
headline: VP R&D | Hands-on CTO | AI Agents & LLM Systems
summary: Hands-on R&D leader with 20+ years in software engineering and 10+ years leading development teams. VP R&D at TinyTap, leading GoEddy, the company's flagship AI tutoring product, end to end, and driving AI adoption across all ~50 employees. Still writes production code daily: AI agents, MCP servers, voice and avatar agents, and full-stack TypeScript / Next.js platforms. Founded and solo-built Workbook, an agent-first EdTech platform with ~1,100 lesson modules and paid subscriptions.

experience.description: EdTech company behind a global educational game-creation platform and GoEddy, an AI tutoring product.

roles.title: VP R&D
highlights: Appointed the company's first VP R&D, a newly created role, while remaining Web Development Team Lead and a hands-on developer.
Lead GoEddy, the company's flagship AI product, end to end: concept, architecture, roadmap and execution.
Drove company-wide AI adoption: designed and built agentic team setups (skills, connectors and plugins) used by all ~50 employees across Design, Sales, Marketing, Development and Project Management.
Build real-time AI agents across text (chatbots), voice (voice agents) and video (AI avatars), and integrate AI services for content and rich-media generation.
Shipped AI content-creation tools used by hundreds of creators on TinyTap's game-creation platform.
Built public MCP servers and AI-discoverability pipelines that let LLM assistants find TinyTap and GoEddy apps and recommend them to users.
Run AI research and rapid prototyping to evaluate emerging technologies for the products and the company.

roles.title: Web Development Team Lead
highlights: Lead development of TinyTap's WebSale and WebCreator web platforms, balancing hands-on frontend work with team leadership, planning and delivery.
Led the integration of generative AI into WebCreator, delivering AI tools that speed up content creation for game creators.
Led the company's blockchain initiative: built the Publisher NFT Dashboard and delivered the $EDU token launch.
Lead web development of GoEddy; grew the team and coordinated cross-platform projects.

roles.title: Founder & Developer
highlights: Founded and single-handedly built an interactive study platform for Israeli middle-school students (grades 7-9), aligned with the Ministry of Education curriculum: product, curriculum architecture, code, content pipelines and launch.
Delivered ~1,100 interactive lesson modules across Science, Math, Geography, History and English, with simulations, quizzes, chapter summaries and 800+ practice pages.
Built AI generators for custom practice sheets (including from PDFs), English dictations and learning games such as crosswords, word searches and mazes.
Architected the platform as agent-first: a public agent API with an OpenAPI spec, an MCP hub serving 23 tools across a network of apps, agent skills, and llms.txt.
Launched free and paid subscription tiers for students, parents and schools.

roles.title: Senior Frontend Developer
highlights: Built reusable React components for Wibbitz Studio, a large-scale online video editor for media publishers, shipping via CI/CD with product, design and BI teams.

roles.title: Web Developer
highlights: Developed Magisto's AngularJS video-creation web app from design to launch, plus React and AngularJS widgets embedded on third-party partner websites.
Coordinated with overseas vendors and partners and prioritized web R&D work.

roles.title: Lead Frontend Developer
highlights: Led a team of 4 developers and QA (planning, deadlines, releases) building the white-label loyalty platform, e-commerce shops and PHP back office.

roles.title: Lead Frontend Developer
highlights: Led a team of 6 developers and QA building websites, finance widgets and a Django-based multilingual social platform for financial-sector clients.
